notes.title: Meet New Demo 0.3 - Exclusively on Steam 🔥🔥🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/2a153c2fad17312f0769486135d341ef2009b2ad.png[/img]

[b]Hey there, gamers! 🔥🔥🔥🔥 I have some fiery news 🔥🔥🔥🔥[/b]
The demo's Steam release is close! And not just a demo, but a new build 0.3, with new content and other changes 💪 This build will participate in the Demo Festival on Steam from the 14th of October, so I would be very grateful if you launch the game both today and on the 14th-15th to support my project 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148070/Summer_For_You_Demo
[h2][b]All available content in the Steam version:[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Prologue + cutscenes
[*] 3 routes: Misha, Naomi and Samantha
[*] Choices and concequences
[*] 3 beautiful H-scenes
[*] 3 minigames (quiz, 2048 and a rhythm game)
[*] Erotic cards
[*] Messenger mechanic
[*] Open world with a handful of locations
[*] Localizations: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, LatAm Spanish, Brazillian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Turkish[/list]
[h2][b]You can leave feedback on the demo version here:[/b] [u][b][url=https://forms.gle/K1Hp3zRcMvKTj5kUA]LINK[/url][/b][/u][/h2]

[h2][b]What's new in 0.3:[/b][/h2]
[olist][*] Samantha's route (the MILF pastry chef)
[*] 3 levels of undress on Samantha's model
[*] H-scene with Samantha
[*] Quest journal
[*] Erotic cards
[*] Messenger fixes
[*] Emotions are now voiced
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] New localization: French[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/942f1bc34dbd010c9cd622427eafaf19e7705180.jpg[/img]

[u][b]ANOTHER IMPORTANT PIECE OF NEWS:[/b][/u] I've decided to delay the release until December 2024 bc I still need time for development. I wanted to release the game as fast as I could, but in the process of making it I realized that I want to make something more than "a simple game" - I want to make "a cool game" that you'll like and remember 💘 I hope you understand my wish - I will not let you down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/78cb8c316eae006ad144b8d3165597e234bc7eac.png[/img]

[h3]Wishlist my game and play the demo! I will be very grateful, and you will help to make the game more popular this way ✨[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148070/Summer_For_You_Demo

notes.content:

- 2 new bed scenes

We are waiting for patch 5.5!

-
Mini-games with special arts will be added to all chapters

This will be a global patch before the release of the game!
If you have already purchased the game,
please write a review for it! This helps in promoting the game and we get feedback that helps us improve the game!
